# rally data — legacy GEVP profile reference

Scope: retained derived profile for provenance and comparison; it is not loaded by the standalone Rally session.
Consumers: none in the standalone Rally scene. The active profile is `game/data/vehicles/ford-escort-rs2000/vehicle.json` and its domain files.
Rules: do not update this legacy GEVP profile to tune the active GDScript vehicle. Record active mappings and approximations in `game/docs/rally/README.md`.

This file remains only as a previous GEVP conversion reference and is not proof that any of its fields are active.
